scope.summary: Implement per-range kerning modes: metrics (from the font's pair-kerning table), optical (computed by the shaping engine from glyph shapes so unrelated/mixed fonts kern evenly), and manual (an explicit per-pair value in 1/1000 em applied at the caret pair). Metrics and optical are automatic; manual overrides at the caret pair (provenance AI/PS/ID kerning modes, deduped).
acceptance_criteria: 3 kerning modes per-range; optical computed from glyph shapes; manual 1/1000 em pair override
expected_tests: live: metrics vs optical vs manual produce distinct advances; optical kerns mixed-font pair evenly
test: manual per-pair 1/1000 em override at caret

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No optical/manual kerning; type spacing quality gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
